{{Quote|Leader, there was nothing we could do.''"<br />"''Wrong, Runck of Domain Das. You could have been faster.|Runck Das and Shedao Shai|<ref name="Ruin" />}}
'''Domain Das''' was a [[Domain]] among the [[Warrior caste]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]. One warrior of Domain Das, [[Runck Das]], served under [[Commander]] [[Shedao Shai]]<ref name="Ruin" /> in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]<ref name="TERC" /> during the early days of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] and took part in the [[Battle of Garqi]], where the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]], [[Ganner Rhysode]] and [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] successfully escaped despite the efforts of Das' direct superior, [[Krag Val]]. When Das returned with news of what happened there for the Commander, Shai [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Gender/Legends|him]] for his and Val's failures.<ref name="Ruin" />

==Behind the scenes==
Domain Das first appeared in the [[2000]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]'' written by [[Michael A. Stackpole]].<ref name="Ruin" />
